title: The Nihilist Reading Of L'enfer c'est les autres #Shorts
description:
Every serious account of L'enfer c'est les autres eventually collides with the question of who is deciding. The play was first performed at the Théâtre du Vieux-Colombier in May 1944. The play centers on a depiction of the afterlife in which three deceased characters are punished by being locked into a room together for eternity.

Nobody designed the part of L'enfer c'est les autres you experience — it was inherited. The production had its world premiere on April 25, 2008, at the Boston Conservatory's Zack Theatre. Vores' opera premiered in Chicago in October 2009 by Chicago Opera Vanguard.
